creative

ad creative

40 or more pieces every week for a luxury product sold into the US, the UK, Europe and Australia. 104 images across 6 variants, built off an 18 prompt system, plus 160 short clips for the feed. Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom and Figma.

photo

Campaign images built and finished for the same luxury product. Shot direction, retouching and colour in Lightroom and Photoshop, cut to every size the feed and the site needed.
